## 5. Community Detection in Heterogeneous Networks

::: {.project-meta}
In progress · PLACEHOLDER: dates · PLACEHOLDER: advisor
:::

How the number of communities should be selected by recursive bipartitioning when
the degree distribution is strongly heterogeneous, and whether spectral stopping
rules calibrated under homogeneous models remain valid in that regime.

**Data** — Wikipedia MUSAE network data. PLACEHOLDER: subgraphs used, node and
edge counts, preprocessing.

**Methods** — Recursive bipartitioning with a Tracy-Widom stopping rule, compared
against a degree-aware alternative built on a degree-corrected stochastic block
model. PLACEHOLDER: simulation design and partition-recovery metrics.
